name: 92373 · Redlands, CA
findings: ZIP 92373 (Redlands) has 196 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92373 (Redlands) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92373 (Redlands) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
